case.query: Man the bathroom air feels kinda dusty my throat is a bit scratchy and my eyes feel gritty, its annoying me a little

transcript.text: The system will check whether the bathroom air purifier is already on; if it is, nothing will be done. If it is off, it will turn the purifier on to high (100% fan), wait up to 15 seconds for it to come on, then enable oscillation so the air circulates. This should help reduce dust and relieve your throat and eye irritation. Does this plan look good to you?
